description_en: Queries the versions of a permission

DefaultPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the permission is the default permission. Valid values:

false: The permission is not the default permission.

true: The permission is the default permission
DefaultPermission.description_zh:
是否为默认权限。取值：

true：是默认权限

DefaultVersion.description_en:

true: The version is the default version
